result:
**DG1 round 3, domain review: PASS. No regressions and no new findings.**

**Candidate:** HEAD is `4f312cc`. I recomputed the candidate ID in the repository and in a disposable clone, and both gave `sha256:18e150714d29fa67…056f5b` with 394 files. Compared with round 2, the only changed file is `apps/web/e2e/journeys.spec.ts`. That is the test-only fix for F-DG1-232: it waits for the shell to be ready before pressing Tab. It weakens no assertion and adds a new check that Enter on the skip link moves focus to the main content.

**Checks run** (all in a disposable clone, all passed, exit 0):

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `pnpm -r typecheck`, `pnpm -r build`, `pnpm lint` (Node 22) | Pass |
| `pnpm test` on Node 22 and on Node 24 | 326/326 on both |
| Colour contrast | 50 required colour pairs meet AA; the 3 known failing pairs are documented and not used for small text |
| No-CDN scan and OpenAPI lint | Pass (33 operations) |
| Search for official PMI or Mobily claims | All 7 matches are disclaimers |
| Integration tests on a disposable PostgreSQL 16 | 209/209 |
| Full e2e journeys, English and Arabic | 18/18 |
| Changed shell journey repeated 15 times per language | 30/30, so the flakiness fix holds |
| Live shell scenario (API probe) | 49/0 |
| Rate-limit probe | 7/0 |

The live shell scenario covered these points:
- **Closure rule:** closing a transformation is refused with 422 from draft, active and on-hold. The message cites the G6 (Sustain) business approval and validated benefits, with no DG7 or approval claim. The record stays unchanged and no audit event is written.
- **Scoped access:** a business-unit Lead gets 404 on records outside their unit, and an admin sees no business records.
- **Database guard:** a direct SQL attempt to create a business-unit cycle is rejected. The worker shuts down cleanly on SIGTERM.

**Screens:** I rendered the login, home and transformations screens in both languages. Arabic is RTL and English is LTR. The text wordmark and colours are marked provisional in both languages, the fonts are bundled, the browser made no external requests, and times show in Asia/Riyadh. The business-unit cycle error is localized and leaves the server data unchanged. I looked at two of the screenshots myself.

**Source fidelity:** the six phases match B0021 and the G1–G6 gates match B0023. They are kept separate from DG0–DG7, and closure is tied to G6 in line with B0014 ("Benefits before closure").

**Not run:** `deps:verify` needs network access to npm, which the sandbox doesn't have. It is outside this assignment.

**Findings:** none new. My round-2 findings F-DG1-001/002/003 stay CLOSED_VERIFIED, as the assignment says.

**Requirement IDs:** I recorded the eight listed IDs plus `REQ-PB-003`, the same set as round 2. That is my reading of the assignment's "+ REQ-PB/§15/§16 rows". `REQ-S16-003` also completes at DG1 but is not in my set; the validator will reject the gate unless the code-security reviewer covers it.

The review record validates against the schema, and every evidence path exists. I deleted the scratch clones and databases.

Files are in `docs/delivery/`:
- reviews/DG1/round-3/domain-reviewer.json
- test-evidence/DG1/domain/round-3/ (logs, scripts and screenshots)
